# `needless-cast`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports nested identical casts or a cast whose operand is proven to already have
the target type.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Redundant casts imply a conversion that does not occur and can conceal the real
type flow.

## When it fires

It applies only with explicit or resolved type equality; uncertain inferred
types are left unchanged.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn f(x: u32) u32 {
    return @as(u32, x);
}
```
